newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers volatile after Monday's fall.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers volatile after Monday's fall.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices were volatile on Tuesday in nervous trade after recent losses, brokers said.
Rotterdam 380 cst closed at $93 a tonne fob after swinging some $3 in either direction over the course of the day.
"It's been hectic but everybody is nervous and it's hard to tell where the market is," one broker said. On Monday 380 cst was quoted at $89 by the close, down $2 on the day.

Antwerp prices were slightly higher, with 380 cst at $94 and 180 cst at $99, while Hamburg prices were markedly down. Hamburg 380 cst was quoted around $92/93, against $97/98 on Monday, with 180 cst at $98.
Augusta prices were also higher, with 380 cst at $115 against $108/110 on Monday, while Fos was stable at $102 for 380 cst and $109 for 180 cst.
Durban 180 cst was unchanged at $96-98. --London newsroom +44 171 542 4088
